name: TouchStone
description: TouchStone is a comprehensive visual dialogue dataset designed to evaluate vision-language models across five major ability categories and 27 subtasks, including recognition, comprehension, and literary creation. It uses strong language models as judges to assess multimodal dialogue quality without human intervention.
reputation: A recent research benchmark that has seen attention in multimodal evaluation papers, but it is not yet a widely standardized community benchmark.
notes: Includes detailed image annotations to enable LLM-based evaluation; aims to comprehensively assess LVLM abilities including conversational and storytelling skills.
